description:
Job Title : Mobile Hybrid Developer
Location : Washington DC
Duration : Contract

Job description:

 Experience developing hybrid mobile applications, with Angular, CSS, HTML 5, JavaScript and other broadly used Web development technologies. 
 Has delivered awesome, hybrid mobile applications that work on both Android and IOS using these technologies.
 Extensive knowledge of mobile APIs and UI standards
 Has web client-side experience – JavaScript, MVVM/MVC Framework (Angular, Knockout, etc.), CSS and HTML
 Experience developing native mobile applications (Android with Java, IOS with Objective-C) a plus
 Experience with one or more server-side stacks (.NET, Node.js, Python, Java, PHP etc.) a plus

Mandatory: LinkedIn presence and for verification share 2 good References from your last two projects.

If you are not interested in the role or if now isn’t a great time for a move, just let me know if I can help in the future.
Thanks for your time,




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
